summary: Resolve integrator attribution probe build and snapshot roots against the build helper's working directory. Relative roots now allocate and clean up probe namespaces consistently even when the integrator starts in another directory.

replay.detail: No data replay; integrator version 13 invalidates prior attribution tree-cache identities.

compatibility.detail: Absolute build and snapshot roots retain their meaning; relative roots now match the existing build helper cwd contract.

manual.detail: No additional rollout action beyond the integrator launcher repin.

recovery.detail: Probe outputs are removed after completion; snapshot cleanup still removes only empty namespaces and preserves any remaining leased snapshots.
